printable-planner-maker: Pick Monthly calendar, Weekly planner, Daily planner or Year at a glance. Each opens with sensible settings.
Enter the year and month, or the first day. Choose how many months, weeks or days to make, which day the week starts on, and the language of the month and day names.
Pick the page size, portrait or landscape, margins, an ink tone and line weight. Add your name or project as a heading on every page.
Flip through the pages in the preview, then download one PDF with all of them, or print the page shown.
printable-meal-planner: Pick Weekly menu, Daily menu or Monthly menu, then tap the meals you want, such as breakfast, lunch, snack, dinner and dessert.
Type the dishes, or leave it blank
Open Adjust everything and type the dishes for each day if you want them printed. Leave them empty to print boxes you write in by hand.
Choose the first date, how many weeks, days or months to make, the page size and landscape or portrait. Add a heading such as Our family menu.
Check the preview, then download one PDF with every page or print the page shown. Stick it on the fridge.
printable-calendar-maker: Pick the starting month and the year. Set how many months to make, up to 24, in one PDF.
Set the week start and language
Choose whether the week starts on Monday, Sunday or Saturday, and the language of the names. Add an optional heading such as your name or team.
Choose A4, A5, US Letter or Legal in landscape or portrait, the margins, an ink tone and the line weight. Turn the notes lines on or off.
Flip through the months in the preview, download the PDF and print it at Actual size.
daily-planner-printable: Pick the first day and how many days
Choose the date of the first page and how many days to make, up to 62, in one PDF.
Choose when your schedule starts and ends, and whether the slots are hourly or every thirty minutes.
Pick the page size, orientation, margins, ink tone and an optional heading with your name or project.
Flip through the pages in the preview, download the PDF and print it at Actual size.
daily-menu-planner-printable: Tap the meals you want for the day, such as breakfast, lunch, snack, dinner and dessert. Each gets its own block.
Pick the day and how many days
Open Adjust everything, choose the first day and how many daily pages to make, up to 62 in one PDF.
Type the dishes, or write them in
Type what you cook for each weekday if you want it printed, or leave the lines empty to write by hand. Turn on the notes lines if you want room for a recipe or a reminder.
Check the preview, then download the PDF or print the page shown.
monthly-menu-planner-printable: Pick which meals matter for your month. The monthly page gives every date a few lines to write the day's dishes.
Open Adjust everything, choose the starting month and year, and how many months to make, up to 12 in one PDF.
Choose landscape for a wall or fridge sheet, and the week start day. Add a heading such as Our family menu, and turn on notes lines if you want a shopping or reminder area.
Check the preview, then download the PDF and print it at Actual size.

plannerMakerGuide.title: Printable Calendar and Planner Maker: Monthly, Weekly, Daily PDF
plannerMakerGuide.subtitle: Make a printable monthly calendar, weekly planner, daily planner or year page for any dates. Set the week start, language and paper, then download a PDF. Free.
faq: Is the planner maker free, and is there a watermark?
It is free, needs no account and adds no watermark. Everything is made in your browser.
Which planner types can I make?
Monthly calendars for any month and year, weekly planners, daily planners with an hourly schedule, priorities and a to-do list, and a year-at-a-glance page with all twelve months.
Can I print a calendar for any year?
Yes, any year from 1900 to 2200. The days of the week are worked out for you, including leap years. For a 12-month calendar, start in January and choose a count of 12 months.
Can I change the hours of the daily planner?
Yes. Choose any start and end hour, for example 6:00 to 22:00 or 9:00 to 17:00, with hourly or half-hourly slots. The half-hour slots suit time blocking and appointments.
Can I make a planner for a whole year?
Yes. Set the monthly calendar to 12 months for twelve monthly pages, the weekly planner to 53 weeks for a full year of weeks, or use the daily planner for up to 62 days. Everything goes into one PDF.
Can I start the week on Monday, Sunday or Saturday?
Yes. The week start changes the order of the days on every page, which matters for school, work and religious or regional calendars.
Which languages are supported?
English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian and Dutch, because the PDF font can show their letters and accents. Languages with other scripts are not supported yet.
Does it print public holidays?
No. Holidays and school terms differ by country, region and year, so the pages are left blank for you to write them in. This also keeps the planner usable in any country.
How do I print all the pages?
Press Download PDF, open the file and print it with "Actual size" selected. The Print button prints only the page shown in the preview.
Is my information uploaded or stored?

No. The pages are drawn and the PDF is built in your browser, and nothing is sent to {{siteName}}. The page still loads advertising and other resources from the network. Your heading text and dates stay on your device.

mealPlannerGuide.title: Printable Meal Planner: Weekly, Daily and Monthly Menu
mealPlannerGuide.subtitle: Make a printable weekly meal planner, daily menu or monthly menu with a shopping list. Type the dishes or write them in. Free, private, a PDF.
faq: Is the meal planner free, and is there a watermark?
It is free, needs no account and adds no watermark. Everything is made in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
How do I make a weekly meal plan I can print?

Choose Weekly menu, tap the meals you want, set the first date and download the PDF. You get seven days down the page with a box for each meal, and an optional shopping list beside it. Write in the dishes, or type them first and they are printed for you.
Can I type the dishes before printing?

Yes. Open Adjust everything, then Type the dishes, and fill in what you cook each day. The same menu repeats on every week you make, which suits a family that eats on a regular rotation. Leave the boxes empty for a blank planner.
Can I add a grocery or shopping list?
Yes. The weekly menu has a shopping list column beside the week. Switch it off if you want the week to use the full width.
Can I make a monthly menu or a whole month of meals?
Yes. Choose Monthly menu for a calendar with room to write the meals under each date. You can make up to 12 months in one PDF.
Can I use it for a school lunch or tiffin plan?
Yes. Keep only Lunch (and Snack if you pack one), choose the weekly menu, and print it for the term. It works the same way for a packed lunch plan, a hostel mess menu or a lunch box rotation.
Can I plan a diet, fasting days or a special diet with it?

You can write any plan you like in it, for example fasting days, vegetarian days or a diet your doctor gave you. The planner only prints your own plan: it does not suggest meals or work out calories or nutrition.
What paper size should I print on?

A4 or Letter in landscape is the best for the weekly menu, because there are seven rows and several meal columns. The daily menu suits portrait. You can also choose A5 or other sizes under Adjust everything.
Does it suggest recipes or what to cook?
No. It is a planner, so you decide the dishes. That keeps it fast and means nothing you type leaves your device.

calendarMakerGuide.title: Printable Calendar Maker: Monthly Calendar PDF for Any Month and Year
calendarMakerGuide.subtitle: Make a printable monthly calendar for any month from 1900 to 2200, with the week starting on Monday, Sunday or Saturday. One month or a whole year, as a PDF.
faq: Can I print a calendar for any year?
Yes, any year from 1900 to 2200. The days of the week are worked out for you, including leap years, so you can print a calendar for a past or future year.
How do I make a 12-month calendar?
Set the starting month to January, choose a count of 12 months and download the PDF. You get twelve pages, one per month, in one file.
Does the calendar include holidays?
No. Holidays differ by country and region and change from year to year, so the boxes are left blank for you to write in your own dates.
Why does a month sometimes have five rows and sometimes six?

The calendar uses only as many rows as the month needs. A month that starts late in the week can spread over six rows, and a short February that starts on the first day of the week may need only four, which gives the boxes more room.
Can I make the week start on Sunday?
Yes. Choose Sunday, Monday or Saturday as the first day. The weekday headings and the day numbers move to match.
What paper should I use?
Landscape A4 or US Letter suits a wall or desk calendar. A5 or portrait works for a diary or binder. Print on thicker paper if you want to write with a pen.
How do I print the whole year at once?
Download the PDF and print it with "Actual size" selected. For a two-sided printout, choose double-sided printing in your print window.
Is my information uploaded or stored?

No. The pages are drawn and the PDF is built in your browser, and nothing is sent to {{siteName}}. The page still loads advertising and other resources from the network. Your heading text and dates stay on your device.

dailyPlannerGuide.title: Daily Planner Printable: Hourly Schedule, Priorities and To-Do List
dailyPlannerGuide.subtitle: Make printable daily planner pages with an hourly or half-hourly schedule, three priorities, a to-do list and notes. Choose your hours, dates and page size.
faq: What is on a daily planner page?

The full date at the top, a schedule down the left side with a line for each hour or half hour, three priorities with tick circles, a to-do list with tick circles and a notes area at the bottom right.
Can I change the hours of the schedule?
Yes. Choose any start and end hour, for example 6:00 to 22:00 for a long day or 9:00 to 17:00 for a workday, and choose hourly or half-hourly slots.
How many days can I print at once?
Up to 62 days, which is two months, in one PDF. Make a new PDF for the next period, or use the weekly planner if you prefer a week on a page.
What is time blocking, and does this suit it?
Time blocking means giving each task a block of time in your calendar. The schedule column with half-hour slots is meant for this: write the task next to the time you plan to do it.
Why only three priorities?
Limiting the day to three main tasks helps you focus on what matters. You can leave one blank, or use the to-do list for smaller tasks.
Should I print portrait or landscape?
Portrait is the classic choice for a daily page. Landscape works if you want wider rows for the schedule, but the lists on the right become shorter.
Can I use it for shifts or appointments?
Yes. Set the hours to match your shift or clinic day, use half-hour slots for appointments and write names next to the times.
Is my information uploaded or stored?

No. The pages are drawn and the PDF is built in your browser, and nothing is sent to {{siteName}}. The page still loads advertising and other resources from the network. Your heading text and dates stay on your device.

dailyMenuGuide.title: Daily Menu Planner Printable: Plan Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner
dailyMenuGuide.subtitle: Make a printable daily menu planner with a block for each meal. Type the dishes or write them in, and print up to 62 days in one PDF. Free and private.
faq: What is on the daily menu planner page?
The full date at the top and one block for every meal you choose, such as breakfast, lunch, snack, dinner and dessert. Each block has lines to write on, and you can type the dish before printing.
Can I plan only dinner, or only lunch?
Yes. Tap the meals you want and leave the others off. A page with only dinner gives you a larger block, which suits a daily dinner plan or a lunch box plan.
How is this different from the weekly meal planner?

The daily page gives each meal a wide block with several lines, so you can write a recipe note or the ingredients you need. The weekly planner shows all seven days at once with a small box for each meal. Choose the daily menu when you want detail for one day.
Can I plan a menu for a party or a festival day?
Yes. Choose the day, tap the meals and use the notes lines for the guest list or extra dishes. Print as many pages as you need, one per day.
How many days can I print at once?
Up to 62 days, which is two months, in one PDF. Choose the first day and the number of days under Adjust everything.
Is my information uploaded or stored?
No. The page is drawn and the PDF is built in your browser, and nothing you type is sent to {{siteName}}. The page still loads advertising and other resources from the network.

monthlyMenuGuide.title: Monthly Menu Planner Printable: Month of Meals on One Page
monthlyMenuGuide.subtitle: Make a printable monthly menu planner: a calendar with room under every date for the day's meals. Choose any month and year, print up to 12 months.
faq: What is on the monthly menu planner?
A calendar for the month you choose, with several lines under each date to write the meals for that day. Notes lines can be added at the bottom for a shopping reminder.
How do I plan a month of meals?
Pick the month, print the page and fill in the main dish for each day first, usually dinner. Repeat the same dishes on a rotation, such as rice on Mondays, to make planning faster.
Can I make a menu for a whole year?
Yes. Start in January, choose 12 months and download one PDF with twelve pages.
Is it suitable for a school, hostel or office canteen menu?
Yes. It prints the dates for the month and leaves the boxes blank, so you or the kitchen staff can write the menu. Print it in landscape and pin it on a notice board.
Why are the boxes blank when I can type dishes in the weekly menu?
The monthly page repeats a month of dates, and a different dish for each date does not fit the typed-menu setup. Use the weekly or daily menu if you want typed dishes, or write the dishes in by hand.
Is my information uploaded or stored?
No. The page is drawn and the PDF is built in your browser, and nothing you type is sent to {{siteName}}. The page still loads advertising and other resources from the network.

sections.heading: What the Printable Calendar and Planner Maker does
paragraphs: It builds planner pages for any dates you choose and gives you one PDF to print. You are not limited to a template for one particular year: pick the start date, the number of pages and the kind of page, and the tool works out the weekdays, the number of weeks in each month and the labels for you.
Because the pages are drawn in your browser, you can try a setting, see the result at once, and change your mind before you print.

sections.heading: Four kinds of page
paragraphs: The monthly calendar shows a month as a grid of days, with space to write in each box and optional lines for notes. The weekly planner gives each day of the week its own block of ruled lines. In landscape it becomes seven columns, in portrait seven rows. The daily planner has an hourly or half-hourly schedule, three priorities, a to-do list with tick circles and a notes area. The year at a glance shows all twelve months on one page.
Together they cover most planning styles: long range overview, month by month, week by week and day by day.

sections.heading: A calendar for the whole year
paragraphs: To make a full year of monthly calendars, choose January as the starting month and 12 as the count. The PDF has twelve pages in order, so you can print them double-sided or pin them up one after another. For a school year, start in the month your term begins and choose up to 24 months.
The calendar is blank by design. You write in birthdays, meetings, deadlines and holidays that matter to you, so it works in any country.

sections.heading: Settings that matter
paragraphs: The week start decides whether Monday, Sunday or Saturday comes first. The language setting changes the names of the months and days. The count lets you make a bundle, for example the next twelve months or the next 53 weeks. The heading line prints your name, a class or a project at the top of each page so that loose sheets are easy to identify.
Page size, orientation, margins, ink tone and line weight work as they do in the paper maker: light tones save ink and stay out of the way of your handwriting.

sections.heading: Planning a single day
paragraphs: The daily page has a schedule down the left and three priorities, a to-do list and notes on the right. Write fixed commitments first, then place the tasks that need focus in the gaps, and leave a few empty slots as buffer. Choose up to 62 days in one PDF.
Plan the day the evening before, start with the three priorities and move unfinished items to the next page.

sections.heading: Planning ideas
paragraphs: Students can print a weekly planner for the whole term and write exam dates on the year page. Small teams can print monthly calendars for a project wall. Parents can print a daily planner for a busy week, and freelancers can use the half-hour schedule for time blocking.
Print double-sided and punch holes to make a planner for a binder, or take the PDF to a print shop for a bound version. The margin setting leaves room for hole punches.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: The planner does not print public holidays, moon phases or religious dates, since these differ by place and year. You can write them in by hand. Month and day names are available in languages that use the Latin alphabet.
Your settings are used only in your browser, and nothing is uploaded to {{siteName}}. If you need the same setup next time, note your choices or use the same links.

sections.heading: What the Printable Meal Planner does
paragraphs: The meal planner makes a weekly, daily or monthly menu as a PDF you can print and stick on the fridge. Choose the meals you want, set the dates, and either write the dishes in by hand or type them first so they print on the sheet.
It runs in your browser, so nothing you type is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why plan meals on paper
paragraphs: A written weekly menu answers the daily “what should we cook?” question once, and turns shopping into a single list instead of several small trips. A plan that the whole family can see also helps when different people cook on different days.
Many people find it easier to keep a plan on the fridge than in a phone app, because everyone sees it without asking.

sections.heading: Weekly, daily and monthly menus
paragraphs: The weekly menu has the seven days down the left, the meals across the top and an optional shopping list on the right. It is the one most families use. The daily menu gives each meal its own block with lines, which suits a detailed day or a busy kitchen. The monthly menu is a calendar with room under each date, useful for a school term, a hostel mess menu or a festival month with special dishes.
Choose a landscape page for the weekly menu and a portrait page for the daily menu.

sections.heading: Tips for a plan you will actually follow
paragraphs: Start with the dinners, because they are the meal people argue about most, and add the other meals once the habit is there. Plan one or two leftover or easy nights each week, and leave a spare box for eating out.

Write the shopping list at the same time as the menu, check it against what is already in the kitchen, and keep the sheet where you can see it. The planner prints only your own plan: it does not give dietary advice, so follow your doctor or dietitian for any special diet.

sections.heading: What the Printable Calendar Maker does
paragraphs: It creates a monthly calendar page for any month and year, with a large writing box for every day. You can make a single month or a bundle of up to 24 months in one PDF. The calendar is drawn from the real dates, so a leap year and the day on which each month starts are always right.
It is a blank calendar by design. You write in birthdays, meetings, deadlines and holidays that matter to you.

sections.heading: Choosing how the week looks
paragraphs: In many countries the week starts on Monday, in others on Sunday, and in some places on Saturday. The calendar lets you choose, and the weekday names across the top change at once. The names can be shown in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian or Dutch.
A short heading line prints your name, class or team at the top of each page, which is handy when you print calendars for several people.

sections.heading: Paper, margins and ink
paragraphs: Landscape pages give each day a wide box, which suits a wall calendar or a desk pad. Portrait pages suit a binder or a diary. Pick A4, A5, US Letter or Legal, and set a margin that suits your printer and any punch holes.
Light tones such as soft gray save ink and keep the grid in the background. For a bold wall calendar, choose charcoal black and the Bold line weight.

sections.heading: Ideas for using the calendar
paragraphs: Print a calendar for each month of the school year and write exam and assignment dates. Use a blank calendar for a content schedule, a meal plan, a habit challenge, a travel plan or shift planning. Print twelve pages, punch them and put them in a folder as a custom yearly calendar.
Because nothing is uploaded, you can use the names of real people and projects without sending them anywhere.

sections.heading: A calendar for the whole year
paragraphs: To make a full year, choose January as the starting month and 12 as the count. The PDF has twelve pages in order, so you can print them double-sided or pin them up one after another. For a school year, start in the month your term begins and choose up to 24 months to cover two terms.
The year at a glance page in the planner maker shows all twelve months on a single sheet. Together with the monthly pages it gives you a long view and a close view of the same year.

sections.heading: Limits and printing tips
paragraphs: The calendar does not print public holidays or festival dates. If you need them, write them in by hand or look them up for your country. Only languages that use the Latin alphabet are available.
Print at Actual size or 100% scale, and turn off Fit to page. Try one page first to make sure the margins suit your printer.

sections.heading: What the Daily Planner Printable does
paragraphs: It prints one page for each day you choose, with the full date at the top. A schedule runs down the left, and on the right are your top priorities, a to-do list and a notes area. You decide the hours in the schedule, the slot length, the page size and the ink tone.
It is a simple way to plan a day on paper, without an app or an account.

sections.heading: Using the schedule
paragraphs: Write fixed commitments first, such as classes, meetings and appointments. Then place the tasks that need focus in the gaps. Half-hour slots give you room for short tasks, and hourly slots keep the page simple.
If you work in blocks, give each block a name rather than a long list. Leave a few empty slots as buffer for the things that always take longer than planned.

sections.heading: Priorities and to-do lists
paragraphs: The three priority lines are for the tasks that would make the day a success even if nothing else got done. Tick each circle when done. The to-do list is for smaller jobs, calls, errands and reminders. Move unfinished items to the next day's page.
A notes area at the bottom is useful for ideas, numbers and decisions that come up during the day.

sections.heading: Setting up a stack of pages
paragraphs: Choose the start date and the number of days, up to 62. Pick portrait for a classic look, margins that leave room for punch holes if you use a binder, and a light tone so your handwriting stands out. Add your name as a heading so loose pages are easy to match.
Print double-sided to halve the paper, and keep the stack on your desk or in a folder.

sections.heading: Habits that make a daily plan work
paragraphs: Plan the day the evening before, when you know what is coming. Start with the three priorities, then fill the schedule around them. Keep the plan realistic: if the schedule has no gaps, one delay will break the whole day.

At the end of the day, tick off what you did, move what you did not do and note anything to remember. A few minutes of review stops tasks from silently disappearing and shows you how long things really take.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: The planner does not know your calendar or holidays, so you add the plan by hand. It has English labels such as Schedule, To do and Notes, while the date follows your chosen language in the full planner. Nothing is uploaded, and the PDF is made in your browser.

sections.heading: What the Daily Menu Planner does
paragraphs: It makes one page for each day, with a block for every meal you choose. You can type the dishes first, so they print on the page, or leave the lines blank and write by hand.
It runs in your browser, so nothing you type is uploaded.

sections.heading: When a daily menu is better than a weekly one
paragraphs: A weekly menu is quick to scan, but each box is small. A daily page gives you room for more: the dish, who is cooking, the ingredients to buy and a note to start something the night before.
It also suits days that are different from the rest, such as a festival, a party, a diet day or a day of cooking in bulk.

sections.heading: Planning one meal at a time
paragraphs: Many families plan only dinner, or only the lunch box. Switch off the other meals and the block for the one you keep becomes larger. Plan the dinner the evening before and soak, marinate or defrost what you need.
The planner prints only your own plan: it does not suggest recipes or give dietary advice.

sections.heading: What the Monthly Menu Planner does
paragraphs: It prints a calendar for the month you choose, with lines under every date for the day's meals. It is the long view of your menu: one sheet for the whole month on the fridge or a notice board.
It runs in your browser, so nothing you write or choose is uploaded.

sections.heading: Who a monthly menu suits
paragraphs: A monthly page works well for a school or hostel mess, an office canteen, a tiffin service or a family that likes to plan the month's cooking and shopping together. It also helps with budgeting, because you can see the whole month's meals at once.
Choose landscape for a wall sheet. Use the notes lines to write a shopping reminder or a list of special days.

sections.heading: How to fill it in quickly
paragraphs: Write the dinners first, because they take the most planning. Then add the other meals, or leave them for the days that need them. Repeating dishes on a rotation, such as a fixed fish, dal or one-pot day each week, makes planning a month take only a few minutes.
Leave one or two blank dates each week for eating out or leftovers.
